Small exercises to get you used to reading and writing [Rust](https://www.rust-lang.org)
code - _Recommended in parallel to reading
[the official Rust book](https://doc.rust-lang.org/book) 📚️_

## Quick start

```bash
# Installation
cargo install rustlings
# Initialization
rustlings init
# Moving into new directory
cd rustlings
# Starting Rustlings
rustlings
```

Visit the [**setup**](@/setup/index.md) page for more details 🧰
